_note: Guide image id to the source files of the screen it shows (H-5). An image is stale when a commit that touches one of its sources is newer than the last commit that touched docs/images/<id>.png. The list 'shared' applies to every image. Each rule adds its sources to every image whose id matches one of its 'ids' patterns (* is a wildcard). A source is a git pathspec: a file, a folder (ends in /) or a pattern with *. Every image id in docs/images needs at least one rule (Tests/GuideImageStaleness.Tests.ps1). The dialogs and the options pages are built in start-apppackager.ps1, a single large file, so an image of one of them is stale after any commit to that file. That is a known over-report: the list is a warning, and a person decides which of the listed images to retake.
